itk_module_test()

if(NOT ITK_USE_MKL AND NOT ITK_USE_CUFFTW)
  get_property(_fftw_precisions GLOBAL PROPERTY ITKFFTW_PRECISIONS)
  foreach(precision IN ITEMS float double)
    if(precision IN_LIST _fftw_precisions)
      string(SUBSTRING ${precision} 0 1 _suffix)
      string(TOUPPER ${_suffix} _suffix)
      set(_test itkFFTW${_suffix}ModuleTest)
      add_executable(${_test} itkFFTWModuleTest.c)
      target_link_libraries(${_test} PRIVATE ITK::ITKFFTWModule)
      if(precision STREQUAL "float")
        target_compile_definitions(${_test} PRIVATE FFTW_TEST_FLOAT)
      endif()
      itk_module_target_label(${_test})
      itk_add_test(NAME ${_test} COMMAND ${_test})
    endif()
  endforeach()
endif()
